name: 0000-MAIN
description: The 0000-MAIN paragraph initializes the program, performs a customer data retrieval routine, and ensures proper resource handling before ending the program.

algorithm.details: Opens files or prepares resources for processing.
Calls the 1000-FETCH-CUSTOMERS paragraph for data retrieval.
Closes files or releases resources after processing.

sideEffects.description: Manages file handles or associated resources being opened and closed during the execution.
